column2: The Telecommunication Levy charged and collected

column1: by any operator authorized under section 2 of the principal
enactment  from  any  recipient  for  the  purposes  authorized
by  this  Act  to  charge  or  collect,  during  the  period
commencing from January 1, 2013 and ending on  March
31, 2013, shall be deemed to have been validly charged and
collected by such operator  under this Act:

column2: Provided  that,  the  aforesaid  provisions  of  this  section

column1: shall not affect any decision or order made by any Court or
any proceedings pending in any Court in respect of any levy
charged and collected during that period.

column2: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala

column1: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
